text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Formidable racers with various motives 
enter the fray for the Spring Grand Prix, 
the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is the goal a result worthy of being 
called the pinnacle of her generation, or 
is it a stepping stone toward taking on 
the world?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the only thought in Tosen 
Jordan's mind was: "I wanna beat Golshi." 
Right now, that was all that mattered.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Tosen Jordan's straightforward 
simplicity, Nakayama Festa was surprised, 
exasperated, laughed... and felt her 
fighting spirit ignite.
